featured.name: Official ATS Convoy - Boat show
featured.description:
### You're **all invited** to haul a boat to Yakima! 👀  

> The yearly Yakima Sprint Boat racing now has a new edition with a regular boat show that is being held at the end of November. For this we require several boats to being hauled to various companies in Yakima from their storage location in Wenatchee.

The event takes place on the **14th November 2026** at **18:00 UTC!**  

---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your timezone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P4sECCF_QEadR)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38596.1792995339.jpg)

---

### :truck: | **Cargo**  

We kindly request you to haul a boat  

You can use our TruckersMP Truck Delivery Dispatcher to select your cargo to Yakima.

![Truck Delivery Dispatcher](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/516fd848-53ae-41ba-9b78-7974591827c0.avif)  

If you want to know more about our Truck Delivery Dispatcher you can read this [article](https://truckersmp.com/knowledge-base/article/1410)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Wenatchee** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you into Coastline Mining.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](https://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121346-official-ats-convoy-boat-show/)**!
featured.rule:

* Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.  
* Participants should park at their designated slots, which is any non-collision company in Wenatchee.  
* Participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.
* Participants must haul a trailer during the convoy. 
* Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited.
* Cars including alternating vehicles are prohibited except for TruckersMP Event Staff assisting with the event. 
* Buses are prohibited.
* Overtaking is strictly prohibited.  
* Free roaming on the server is prohibited.
* All other [TruckersMP rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules) apply.  

**Event Rules for Event Staff**  
* Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.  
* Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.  
* All other [TruckersMP rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules) apply.

featured.name: 4th Anniversary of GTLegion VTC
featured.description:
![](https://i.postimg.cc/V66kj3VD/9877.jpg)

# **🎉 VTC GTLEGION — 4th Anniversary 🎉**

VTC GTLEGION is proud to invite you to join us for a very special occasion — the celebration of our 4th Anniversary.


Over the years, VTC GTLEGION has become much more than just a virtual trucking company. It has grown into a strong community of people connected by the same roads, shared interests, and a passion for TruckersMP.


Thousands of kilometers driven together, countless events, late-night convoys, new friendships, and unforgettable memories have all become part of our shared journey.

For us, this anniversary is not only a celebration of the company itself, but also a celebration of every single person who has ever been part of VTC GTLEGION and supported us throughout the years.


It is thanks to our community, friendship and mutual support that we continue to grow, develop and move forward.



-----

🤝 **Our Partners & Friends**

We would like to dedicate special words of appreciation to our partners, allied communities, and friendly VTCs.


Throughout the years, you have stood beside us — supporting our ideas, participating in our events, sharing unforgettable moments, and helping make every occasion truly special.
To us, you are far more than partners; you have become part of the VTC GTLEGION family.


Thanks to relationships like these, the TruckersMP community continues to be a place where people find friendship, teamwork, and memories that stay with us for years to come.


We are sincerely grateful to every community and every participant for your trust, support, and cooperation.
It is an honor for us to celebrate this important milestone together with all of you.



-----


📸 **Anniversary Event**

To celebrate the 4th Anniversary of VTC GTLEGION, we are organizing a special event that will bring together our community, friends, partners, and guests from across the TruckersMP community.


This event marks an important milestone in the history of VTC GTLEGION, and we are looking forward to sharing this special moment with all of you.



-----

today.description:
## EXPORT OF ELECTRONICS TO EU INOVATION DAYS!
- Export nejmodernější elektroniky na Evropské Inovační Dny. 
## 

-----

![](https://i.imgur.com/VNkKbOc.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/jD3mPFj/CONVOY-RULES.png)


1. Respect the instructions on our Discord server - **Luky Transport Discord Server.**
2. Drive according to the rules and avoid accidents.
3. Follow company rules, they are of great importance.
4. Stick to the prescribed schedule and convoy plan.
5. Have your job and truck ready at the start of the convoy. (FULL FUEL)
6. Cargo is limited to the Electronics.
7. Confirm your participation.
8. If your company has more than 5 members and you want to participate, you must reserve a slot on our Discord server - [link here.](https://discord.gg/lukytransport)
9. The convoy is mainly organized in Czech language, if you need please use translator, we will also use English.

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/PCv3Xb9/schedule.png)

*  **20:00**  - Meetup at parking slots in Stuttgart.
*  **20:30** -  Departure from the Stuttgart, Slots.
*  **20:50** -  Passage trough the city of Hannover.
*  **21:15** -  Passage trough the Germany // BeNeLux border.
*  **21:25** -  Convoy arrival to the Brussels.
*  **21:30** -  Final group photo and end of the event.

![](https://i.imgur.com/qPEhXyX.png)

![](https://i.imgur.com/MyiF3zs.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/CKRRfZ8/CJ.png)

**1. Stuttgart, BCP // Stokes - Brussels, Transinet.**

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/Kctz2JT/SLOT-RESERVATION.png)


To ride on this convoy for companies with more than 5 MEMBERS, slot registration is required.

For this, simply use the new slot feature on our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/lukytransport).

**Correct Registration Procedure:**

1. [Select your slot](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225995618955300874) with the code number in the room or on the convoy page.
2. Create a new ticket for booking a slot in the [#ticket room on our Discord.](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225533050616676544)
3. Fill out the registration form, indicating the slot you are interested in.
4. Our management will confirm your registration through the ticket.

*Remember to monitor slot occupancy on the server and communicate with us.*

* Event Staff overtaking the convoy cannot be performed by more than 2 members at a time.
* Event Staff can drive the incorrect way where roads have a central reservation barrier ONLY. In accordance with the rule above.
* Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.
* Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff
* All other TruckersMP rules apply.

upcoming.description:
🎉 1 Jahr Koggen Crew Logistik  Jubiläumskonvoi 🎉

Die Koggen Crew Logistik KCL feiert ihr einjähriges Bestehen! 🥳 Zu diesem besonderen Anlass laden wir euch herzlich zu unserem großen Jubiläumskonvoi ein.

Gemeinsam möchten wir dieses besondere Ereignis feiern und eine unvergessliche Ausfahrt durch Skandinavien erleben. Wir freuen uns auf zahlreiche Teilnehmer, unsere Partner und eine starke Gemeinschaft!

![](https://i.postimg.cc/s2WF55bp/image-21.jpg)

- Anlass: 1 Jahr Koggen Crew Logistik
- Datum: Samstag, 14.11.2026
- Spiel: Euro Truck Simulator 2 (ETS2)
- Server: Simulation 2
- Start: Stockholm 
- Ziel: Bergen – Polaris Lines 
- Treffen: 18:00 Uhr
- Abfahrt: 19:00 Uhr
- Streckenlänge: ca. 1.100 km

![](https://i.postimg.cc/vmnR55CH/wihtiug1.jpg)

📍 Ablauf

Bitte findet euch rechtzeitig um 18:00 Uhr in Stockholm ein, damit wir die Aufstellung und letzten Vorbereitungen vornehmen können.

Die gemeinsame Abfahrt erfolgt pünktlich um 19:00 Uhr. Wir bitten alle Fahrer, rechtzeitig vor Ort zu sein und den Anweisungen der Konvoileitung zu folgen, damit wir sicher und geordnet unser Ziel in Bergen erreichen.
![](https://i.postimg.cc/B65dV4St/ab-11.jpg)
![](https://files.foxlog.eu/api/public/dl/ypm8cp1x?inline=true)


Ein Jahr KCL  und viele weitere gemeinsame Kilometer vor uns!

Ein großes Dankeschön geht an alle Fahrer, Partner und Unterstützer, die uns auf diesem Weg begleitet haben. Ohne euch wäre dieses erste Jahr nicht das, was es heute ist.

Lasst uns gemeinsam unser Jubiläum feiern und diesen Konvoi zu einem besonderen Erlebnis machen!

Auf viele weitere Jahre, erfolgreiche Touren und eine starke Gemeinschaft!

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
ItsNicho Inhaber
Koggen Crew Logistik KCL 🚛💙

![](https://i.postimg.cc/L43pyB55/links1.jpg)

Discord: https://discord.gg/sZRKPvsHZk  Webseite: https://koggencrew-logistik.vtchub.de/
upcoming.rule:
![](https://i.postimg.cc/jjfVyyBv/links11.jpg)

Für die Teilnahme am KCL-Jubiläumskonvoi am 14.11.2026 gelten folgende Regeln. Wir bitten alle Teilnehmer, diese einzuhalten, damit ein reibungsloser Ablauf gewährleistet ist.

🚛 1. Singletrailer verwenden
Alle Teilnehmer fahren mit einem Singletrailer. Doppel- und Dreifachanhänger sind nicht erlaubt.

⚙️ 2. Zufällige Straßenereignisse und Umleitungen deaktivieren
Bitte stellt sicher, dass zufällige Straßenereignisse sowie Umleitungen ausgeschaltet sind.

⛽ 3. Vollgetankt und repariert erscheinen
Alle Fahrer müssen mit einem vollgetankten und vollständig reparierten Lkw am Treffpunkt erscheinen. Tankstopps und Reparaturpausen sollen während des Konvois möglichst vermieden werden.

🤝 4. Anweisungen der Konvoileitung beachten
Bitte folgt den Anweisungen der Konvoileitung und haltet ausreichend Abstand zum vorausfahrenden Fahrzeug.

Vielen Dank für eure Unterstützung und euer Verständnis!

Wir freuen uns auf einen schönen und unfallfreien Jubiläumskonvoi mit euch!

Eure Koggen Crew Logistik KCL 🚛
